conv.speaker: MALT
conv.log: And so, we arrived at the Boss Room...

conv.speaker: MALT
conv.log: Yes, we were finally able to open the pub we had always dreamed of!

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: It is perfect!... but, there’s a slight problem.

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: The dungeon is so deep underground that we need infrastructure, like an elevator, to bring customers in.

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: We came all the way here to save on RENT! Now the elevator installation costs even more!

conv.speaker: MALT
conv.log: But we found a lot of treasure here, didn't we?

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: Hmm, we did find some. But... honestly, it’s nowhere near enough. It’s worth much less than I thought.

conv.speaker: MALT
conv.log: Then what are you going to do?

conv.speaker: BOB
conv.log: I have to go back to making Malts!

conv.speaker: MALT
conv.log: Then what about the beer? Are you going to make it?
